title: Nine Years at Sea
subtitle: 船长与队长 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 船长与队长（文学艺术与体育·竞技与团队）
meta: 主题语境：船长与队长（文学艺术与体育·竞技与团队）　|　核心词汇：captain　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 captain 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1949 my mother was sent to follow ① a captain she could not name, and she said the naming was the whole of the lesson. The ② captain, meaning the man and not the ship, was nine years at sea and was obeyed by whoever came last; a captain, she said, is the only thing on a deck that is judged by how much has been taken out of him.

Every ③ captain in that fleet had the same coat, and the ④ captain at the end, meaning the one the crew trusted and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever followed properly. A captain, my grandmother said, is nine parts habit and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the habit is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ captain was the whole of the team, meaning the side he led and not the man. The ⑥ captain, meaning the side and not any of that, is the only thing in a match that everybody cheers and nobody questions; a captain, he said, is either someone you follow or the only word that means both a man and a side. She said the side is the part they remember.

By 1965 the ⑦ captain had become a photograph in a report, and the report had become an argument about the coat. The ⑧ captain of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine years and eleven years of following; a captain, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ captain I remember is the one at the end, which was drawn in 1970 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ captain, my grandmother said in 1975, is the only thing that improves by being trusted; every captain, she said, is a side that has agreed to look like a man. She said the side was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 船长；队长；上尉
B. n. 船长（指那个人本身，与船相对）
C. 固定搭配：follow a captain 跟随一位船长／队长
D. n. 船长（指船队里每一位）
E. n. 船长（指末尾那一位）
F. n. 队长（抽象：他带领的那支队伍）
G. n. 那支队伍（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a captain she could not name
The captain, meaning the man and not the ship
captain was the whole of the team
the captain had become a photograph in a report
The captain of the whole thing
A captain, my grandmother said in 1975

answers.why: follow a captain 意为“跟随一位船长／队长”，1949 年母亲被派去跟随一位她说不出名字的船长。
captain 意为“船长”，指那个人本身而不是船，出海九年，由最后走的人服从。
captain 指船队里每一位船长，每一位都是同样的外套。
captain 指末尾那一位（船员信的那一位），是唯一有人真心跟随过的。
captain 意为“队长”，抽象指他带领的那支队伍，父亲说 captain 就是那支队的全部。
captain 为抽象用法，指那支队伍本身，是比赛里人人都欢呼、却没人质疑的东西。
captain 意为“船长、队长”，到 1965 年这位 captain 成了报告里的一张照片。
captain 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九年海上生涯和十一年的跟随。
captain 意为“船长”，我记得的是末尾那一位，1970 年被画下，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
captain 为抽象总称，祖母说船长是唯一会因为被信任而变好的。

Every captain in that fleet had the same coat.
The captain at the end, meaning the one the crew trusted and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever followed properly.
My father said captain was the whole of the team, meaning the side he led and not the man.
